content: 15-second, 16:9 premium technology launch film for an ordinary carrot. Pure black background, immaculate studio lighting, cinematic macro photography, ultra-slow rotation, minimalist white sans-serif titles, ethereal electronic score. Treat the absurd subject with total seriousness and restraint. Keep the same photorealistic carrot throughout: rich orange-red skin, fine vertical ridges, short fresh green stems.  [0–4s] A full, straight carrot floats and slowly rotates in darkness. Cool white rim light defines its silhouette; a soft warm highlight moves across the skin. Macro droplets roll slowly over the surface. Fade in: “Carrot Pro” “Remarkably fresh.”  [4–8s] Three fast studio macro shots: 1. A moist cross-section reveals radial fibers and subtle rings under precise top light. Title: “Vibrant.” 2. The long curve and fine ridges form a sculptural silhouette in side backlight. Title: “Crisp.” 3. Fine mist lands on the skin; droplets cling to the grooves in ultra-slow motion. Title: “Sweet.”  [8–12s] The carrot turns gracefully in midair; its green stems respond with natural inertia. A clean human hand enters from below, catches it securely, then rotates it with believable weight and grip. A restrained orange-gold light trail traces the silhouette as the music reaches a monumental climax. Hero shot like revolutionary flagship hardware. Display: “The most powerful carrot ever.” “20% crunchier than the previous generation.”  [12–15s] The music resolves. The same carrot stands upright, floating alone at center frame with generous negative space. Display: “From $3” “Carrot Pro. Rooted in flavor.” End with one clean electronic chime and hold the final frame like a product poster.  No dialogue. Accurate specified text only. No extra subtitles, logos, kitchen, utensils, soil, packaging, anthropomorphism, or deformed hands. Preserve carrot shape, color, and proportions across every shot.
